recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not revert the element to code or a required binding for FHIR-34348; handle any future THO migration or broader terminology revision under FHIR-55255 or another applied/published follow-up.
issue_request: FHIR-34348 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification OO R5 change request to add DeviceDefinition.productionIdentifierInUDI 0..* code for production identifiers expected in the UDI carrier on the device label, with an extensible binding containing lot-number, serial-number, manufactured-date, expiration-date, biological-source, and software-version.
initial_application: Source history shows the issue was applied: a6b6ef24d89242c1bd430f7c73a963856a2b8e79 added the element, 5bcd0301a3b10ea179804e72e69f1cafa3975bbb corrected the path to DeviceDefinition.productionIdentifierInUDI, and 3877ba2aec57052097910f011950241d6e752dff plus f8399864d57188dd3a13a2802952ea383d6c6c77 added and renamed the supporting terminology artifacts.
additional_context: DeviceDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini. Current source has productionIdentifierInUDI as 0..* CodeableConcept with an extensible binding to ValueSet/device-productidentifierinudi, and the companion code system/value set contain the six requested codes. Later Applied FHIR-43167 changed the element to CodeableConcept and added jurisdictional guidance; FHIR-55255 is later terminology/THO background but remains Resolved - change required.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current authoritative source already implements the FHIR-34348 semantics and no current build source correction is needed.
